pages.title: Silent playback
pages.text: Check listener range, volume, linked Speaker ID, controller input and access policy.$(br2)A proxy needs a loaded linked speaker network.$(br2)Directionality can silence listeners behind the front.

pages.title: Files and streams
pages.text: Use real MP3/WAV data within the upload limit.$(br2)Streams need a direct public URL and server permission.$(br2)Check matching mod versions and required dependencies if playback fails.
